title: Illume
shortDesc: Topological learning engine and multi-source RAG pipeline for instantly understanding complex codebases.
features: Engineered a topological learning engine using FastAPI and Tree-sitter, executing Kahn’s algorithm across parsed AST dependency graphs to generate customized codebase reading paths for 500+ files.

Architected a multi-source RAG pipeline utilizing Celery, vectorizing 5,000+ Git commits, pull requests, and semantic code nodes into pgvector to answer deep architectural queries with traceable source citations.

Built an interactive Next.js 15 onboarding dashboard, visualizing 1,000+ node architectures in 3D while instantly identifying critical file bus-factors and streaming real-time ingestion telemetry via WebSockets.
Deployed the backend to an Azure VM via a Docker + GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, with Nginx as a reverse proxy, handling SSL termination and WebSocket upgrades.

title: Nimbus
shortDesc: Monorepo-based workspace with real-time rich-text editing and infinite canvas collaboration.
features: Architected a horizontally scalable WebSocket microservice using Node.js and Socket.io, integrating a Redis Pub/Sub adapter to concurrently handle 1,000+ state broadcasts/min with low-latency delivery.

Implemented a CRDT engine with Yjs, resolving multi-client merges via incremental binary state updates and eliminating 90% of state-syncing conflicts across rich-text (Milkdown) and canvas (Excalidraw) surfaces.
Built an AI agent that generates Markdown documents and Excalidraw whiteboards from prompts using Qwen and GPT-OSS, streaming content live into the shared canvas for all collaborators.

Engineered a monorepo-based workspace in Next.js supporting 5+ concurrent editors, with native WebRTC voice rooms (self-hosted Coturn relay) and Better-Auth access control within a unified Turborepo pipeline.

title: Recall
shortDesc: RAG-based study platform that turns uploaded coursework into a queryable knowledge base with cited answers, auto-generated quizzes, and spaced repetition.
features: Designed a RAG pipeline using Unstructured.io for layout-aware PDF/PPTX/DOCX parsing, chunking content into 512-token segments with page-level metadata before embedding via OpenAI's text-embedding-3-small into pgvector with an HNSW index.

Architected a hybrid retrieval flow combining pgvector cosine similarity search with Postgres full-text search, merged via Reciprocal Rank Fusion, to return citation-traceable answers down to the exact source page.
Built an SM-2 spaced repetition engine and auto quiz generator (MCQ, short-answer, true/false) with NLP-based semantic scoring for grading open-ended responses.

Set up a FastAPI + Celery + Redis backend on Docker Compose for async document ingestion and quiz generation, with Supabase handling auth, Postgres, and file storage, deployed via GitHub Actions CI/CD.
Built the Next.js 15 frontend with a streaming chat interface, in-app PDF viewer with citation highlighting, and Recharts-based study analytics dashboard.

title: Echoes
shortDesc: A blazing-fast, real-time social platform for immersive threaded conversations, built on React 19 and the TanStack ecosystem.
features: Architected a Node.js/Express backend with Drizzle ORM exposing 35+ REST endpoints, secured end-to-end with JWT-based authentication.
Built a deeply nested threaded-reply system supporting likes and bookmarks, with infinite scroll sustaining 10,000+ interactions without pagination breaks.
Reduced redundant server round-trips by 60% using TanStack Query's caching and background synchronization for near-instant UI updates.
Integrated an AI-powered content moderation engine interfacing with a GPT-5 pipeline to validate and act on flagged reports directly from the report modal.
Enforced type-safe form handling and validation across all user flows using Zod and React Hook Form.

title: Ada
shortDesc: A streamlined online code editor with preloaded boilerplate and macros built to speed up competitive programming workflows.
features: Deprecated.
Built a fully responsive online compiler using Monaco Editor, preloading language-specific boilerplate across 5 coding formats so users can jump straight into problem-specific logic.
Implemented predefined coding shortcuts and macros to reduce keystroke overhead during timed competitive programming rounds.
Designed a no-login, instant-execution flow with one-click code copy for direct submission to judges.
Added 10 customizable editor themes and adjustable font sizing, with state persisted client-side via Zustand.

title: Budgex
shortDesc: A full-stack personal finance manager with AI-generated spending insights, savings goals, and real-time budget analytics.
features: Designed a relational schema in Prisma/PostgreSQL modeling users, categorized expenses, income, and savings goals with cascading deletes on goal-contribution records.
Built a real-time dashboard with Recharts visualizing weekly spend trends, monthly distribution, and category-wise breakdowns, backed by server-side paginated transaction history across 500+ records.
Engineered a GPT-driven daily notification engine that analyzes historical spending by category and day-of-week to surface non-repetitive, behaviorally-aware nudges via a scheduled cron job.
Implemented secure authentication with bcrypt password hashing and JWT session management via `jose`, enforced through Next.js middleware route protection.
Built a savings goals module with target tracking, visual progress bars, and a full contribution history per goal.

title: FloatChat
tagline: Conversational RAG Interface for Ocean (ARGO Float) Data
shortDesc: A RAG-powered chat interface built for SIH 2025, letting users query oceanographic ARGO float datasets in natural language.
features: Built as part of Team Astra for Smart India Hackathon 2025, developing a natural-language chat interface over structured ARGO ocean float datasets.
Engineered a data ingestion pipeline converting raw CSV oceanographic records into structured JSON for downstream retrieval.
Implemented a RAG pipeline over the ingested dataset, enabling the chat interface to answer natural-language queries grounded in the underlying float data.
Contributed to a client/backend split architecture separating the conversational frontend from the ingestion and query-serving backend.

title: Eidetic
shortDesc: A full-stack minigames website with persistent user data and type-safe validation throughout.
features: Built a full-stack minigames platform on Next.js with a PostgreSQL database managed through Prisma ORM.
Enforced end-to-end type safety across the stack using TypeScript and Zod schema validation.
Designed and styled a responsive UI with Tailwind CSS across multiple game modules.
